title: Filter and rank with lambdas
prompt: Given the `Student` struct in the boilerplate, implement `std::vector<Student> passing(const std::vector<Student>& students, int cutoff)` returning students with `score >= cutoff`, ordered by score **descending**. Use `std::copy_if` with a capture-by-value lambda, then `std::sort` with a comparator lambda.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: Highest score first — the comparator returns a.score > b.score.

tests.name: all-pass-tied
tests.hint: Ties are acceptable — stability is not part of this contract.
